    if (n != 1) reachable(f(n), counter + 1) else counter

fun main() {
    fun readInt() = readLine()!!.toInt()
    fun readLong() = readLine()!!.toLong()
    fun readInts() = readLine()!!.split(" ").map(String::toInt)
    fun readLongs() = readLine()!!.split(" ").map(String::toLong)

    val (x1, y1, x2, y2) = readLongs()
    val (x3, y3, x4, y4) = readLongs()
    val (x5, y5, x6, y6) = readLongs()

    var whiteArea = (y2 - y1) * (x2 - x1)
    if (x3 < x2 && x4 > x1 && y3 < y2 && y4 > y1) {
        val left = max(x1, x3)
        val right = min(x2, x4)
        val bottom = max(y1, y3)
        val top = min(y2, y4)
        whiteArea -= (top - bottom) * (right - left)
    }

    if (x5 < x2 && x6 > x1 && y5 < y2 && y6 > y1) {
        val left = max(x1, x5)
        val right = min(x2, x6)
        val bottom = max(y1, y5)
        val top = min(y2, y6)
        whiteArea -= (top - bottom) * (right - left)
    }
    print(if (whiteArea > 0) "YES" else "NO")
}

fun soucetRady(n: Long) = n * (n + 1) / 2
fun soucetCisel(a: Long, b: Long) = max(0, soucetRady(b) - soucetRady(a - 1))

fun main() {
    val (a, b, c, d) = readLine()!!.split(" ").map { it.toLong() }
    var number = 0L
    for (i in c..d) {
        val aa = max(a, i + 1 - c)
        val pocet = b - aa + 1
        val pocet2 = c - b + 1
        val start = min(c - i + aa, pocet2)
        number += soucetCisel(start, min(pocet2, pocet + start - 1))
        number += (pocet - min(pocet2 - start + 1, pocet)) * pocet2
    }
    println(number)
}

fun gcd(a: Long, b: Long): Long {
    var aa = a
    var bb = b
    while (bb > 0) {
        val t = aa
        aa = bb
        bb = t % bb
    }
    return aa
}
